connect_discord_adapter: connect a DiscordAdapter instance to a Discord bot with token and intents configuration
send_discord_message: send a formatted message to a Discord channel or thread with reply reference support
join_discord_voice_channel: join a Discord voice channel in a guild and start voice packet listening
check_discord_requirements: check if the discord.py library and voice dependencies are installed and available
create_discord_thread: create a new Discord thread in a text channel with auto-archive duration setting
